title: A gentle reminder (night sky, reminder reel, Painted 2D)

captions.instagram:
You've been hard on yourself again. 🌙

Count what you did carry: the mornings you got up anyway, the days you kept going.
You're not behind. You're on your own road.
Tonight, talk to yourself the way you'd talk to a friend.

Send this to someone who needs a gentle reminder.

#selfcompassion #gentlereminder #selfkindness #soundmind
